claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Charley Gallagher on 17 August 1869.
claims.excerpt: fight with Charlie Gallagher, un the 17th inst.,

claims.statement: Riley said that in the fifth round Allen punished Gallagher severely and that Gallagher was at Allen's mercy until the last round.
claims.excerpt: In this round Allen hit Gallagher where, and as often as he wanted to, punishing nim

claims.statement: Riley said Kelly, Gallagher's second, threw up the sponge as a token of Gallagher's defeat.
claims.excerpt: This was, 1 consider, a token of the defeat

claims.statement: Riley said referee Larry Wessells told Allen and Riley that Allen had won the fight.
claims.excerpt: said yes. Mr. Alien alse asked him, and he gave the

claims.statement: Riley said Gallagher struck Allen on the cheek after Allen offered to shake hands.
claims.excerpt: struck at Allen, the blow catching him on the cheek

claims.statement: Riley told Allen to leave the ring because the crowd would murder him.
claims.excerpt: or he would be murdered by the rough crowd.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Shake hands, Charlie; Ive gut the best of you to-day.
quotes.topic: to Gallagher after the sponge was thrown up

fights.excerpt: fight with Charlie Gallagher, un the 17th inst.,
fights.notes: Riley's account as Allen's second; the referee later declared the fight a draw on 1869-08-20.

notes: Partisan account by Allen's second, written 1869-08-17 and printed 1869-08-26. Riley's account of the referee's decision is contradicted by the later draw.
